game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Week 6 examination practice: Maze 5 (19×13, 52 junctions): collect 2 crystal(s) from the branches and reach beacon (17, 11). Use a C main program to Program synthesis. Print [32]; final file-scope values must be {}.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Creating Simple C Programs and Program Structure

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the sundial from scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass: keep the boss_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: boss_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Sandstorm Pass Defense
hint: Use printf with stdio.h. File-scope declarations belong before main; block locals hide names only within that block. Coordinates start at the top left.
